name: Sunlight & Happiness by D'Ann Boal
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
The Sunlight & Happiness image recipe was designed to infuse your photos with a soft and luminous glow. This recipe enhances natural sunlight by softening shadows and brightening highlights. Perfect for capturing a variety of moments in sunlight, it refines colors and tones, lightening the greens while warming up the yellows. Highlights, green and yellow tones are brightened, with a subtle boost in contrast adding saturation to the image.  
Whether you're enhancing outdoor portraits, landscapes, or everyday scenes, Sunlight & Happiness will add luminosity and warmth to your image.
